---
title: "watershedBC — Watershed Analysis Report"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
output:
  pdf_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    fig_caption: true
    latex_engine: pdflatex
    number_sections: true
    keep_tex: true
    self_contained: false
    pandoc_args:
      - "--no-highlight"
geometry: "top=1in, bottom=1in, left=1in, right=1in"
fontsize: 11pt
# header-includes:
#   - \usepackage{booktabs}
#   - \usepackage{longtable}
#   - \usepackage{array}
#   - \usepackage{float}
#   - \usepackage{xcolor}

#   - \fancyhf{}
#   - \fancyhead[L]{\small watershedBC (v0.1 PROTOTYPE)}

#   - \fancyfoot[C]{\small \thepage}
#   - \renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.4pt}
params:
  watershed_name:        "Unknown"
  watershed_source:      "Unknown"
  watershed_area_km2:    0
  run_modules:           !r character(0)
  new_leaflet:           null
  gg_map_static:         null    # ← add this

  # Streamflow & Freshwater1
  gg_discharge:          null
  gg_hyps:               null
  gg_fwa:                null
  table_named:           null
  # Forest Disturbance
  gg_timeseries:         null
  gg_timeseries_cumsum:  null
  gg_eca:                null
  gg_elevbins:           null
  gg_dra:                null
  # CEF Human Disturbance
  bc_cef_2021_sum:       null
  bc_cef_2021_sum_flag:  null
  # Stream Profile
  gg_profile:            null
  # Water Allocations
  water_auth:            null
  # ClimateBC
  gg_mat:                null
  gg_map_clim:           null
  gg_pas:                null
  gg_cmd:                null
  # Snow Remote Sensing
  p_snow_map:            null
  p_snow_elev:           null
  # Landslide Zonation
  gg_rlf_map:            null
  gg_rlf_mapz:           null
  gg_rlf_slp:            null
  gg_rlf_slpz:           null
  gg_rlf_ls:             null
  # Satellite Imagery
  r1985:                 null
  r2020:                 null
  r2023:                 null
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo        = FALSE,
  warning     = FALSE,
  message     = FALSE,
  results     = "asis",
  fig.pos     = "H",
  out.width   = "100%"
)
options(knitr.table.format = "latex")   # force kable to latex, not html
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(terra)
library(knitr)
library(sf)
cat("[REPORT] Setup complete\n")
```


\newpage

# Watershed Summary

```{r summary-table}
df_summary <- data.frame(
  Field = c("Watershed name", "Data source", "Area", "Modules run", "Report generated"),
  Value = c(
    params$watershed_name,
    params$watershed_source,
    paste0(format(params$watershed_area_km2, big.mark = ","), " km\u00b2"),
    if (length(params$run_modules) > 0) paste(params$run_modules, collapse = "; ") else "None",
    format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M %Z")
  )
)
knitr::kable(df_summary, col.names = c("", ""), booktabs = TRUE,
             caption = "Watershed report summary.", format = "latex")
cat("[REPORT] 1\n")
```

**Disclaimer:** watershedBC is a prototype — results are not validated and should not be
used for regulatory or engineering decisions.

# Module Results

```{r no-modules-msg, results='asis', eval=length(params$run_modules) == 0}
cat("*No modules were selected for this report.*\n")
```

<!-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ STREAMFLOW -->

```{r sf-header, results='asis', eval=module_run("Streamflow and Freshwater")}
cat("## Streamflow and Freshwater\n\n")
```

```{r sf-discharge, fig.cap="Estimated daily mean discharge. Reference station scaling model (prototype — not validated).", fig.height=4, eval=module_run("Streamflow and Freshwater") && !is.null(params$gg_discharge)}
print(params$gg_discharge)
```

```{r sf-hyps, fig.cap="Basin hypsometric curve with h60 index and Melton Ratio.", fig.height=4, eval=module_run("Streamflow and Freshwater") && !is.null(params$gg_hyps)}
print(params$gg_hyps)
```

```{r sf-fwa, fig.cap="Freshwater Atlas water body coverage (lakes, wetlands, glaciers) by type.", fig.height=3.5, eval=module_run("Streamflow and Freshwater") && !is.null(params$gg_fwa)}
print(params$gg_fwa)
```

```{r sf-table, eval=module_run("Streamflow and Freshwater") && !is.null(params$table_named), results='asis'}
cat("**Named watersheds intersecting this basin:**\n\n")
knitr::kable(
  params$table_named %>% dplyr::rename(Name = gnis_name, `Area (km²)` = area_km2),
  booktabs = TRUE, caption = "Named FWA sub-basins — upstream, watershed of interest, and downstream.", format = "latex"
)
```

<!-- ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════ CEF HUMAN DISTURB -->

```{r cef-header, results='asis', eval=module_run("CEF Human Disturbance - 2021")}
cat("## CEF Human Disturbance — 2021\n\n")
```

```{r cef-group, fig.cap="CEF Human Disturbance 2021 — area by disturbance group (km\u00b2).", fig.height=4, eval=module_run("CEF Human Disturbance - 2021") && !is.null(params$bc_cef_2021_sum)}
params$bc_cef_2021_sum %>%
  mutate(label = gsub("BTM - ", "", gsub("_", " ", cef_disturb_group))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(reorder(label, area), area, fill = cef_human_disturb_flag)) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Area (km\u00b2)", fill = "Flag",
       title = "CEF Human Disturbance 2021 — by disturbance group")
```

```{r cef-flag, fig.cap="CEF Human Disturbance 2021 — area by high-level flag.", fig.height=3, eval=module_run("CEF Human Disturbance - 2021") && !is.null(params$bc_cef_2021_sum_flag)}
params$bc_cef_2021_sum_flag %>%
  mutate(label = gsub("_", " ", cef_human_disturb_flag)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(reorder(label, area), area)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") + coord_flip() + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Area (km\u00b2)",
       title = "CEF Human Disturbance 2021 — by flag")
```

```{r wa-plot, fig.cap="Annualised water allocation volumes by licence/approval type. All quantities converted to m\u00b3/yr.", fig.height=3.5, eval=module_run("Water Allocations") && !is.null(params$water_auth)}

# Data Sources and Disclaimers

**watershedBC is a prototype.** All outputs are indicative only and have not been validated.
Do not use for regulatory, engineering, or water management decisions.

| Module | Primary Source |
|---|---|
| Watershed polygons | BC Freshwater Atlas; Water Survey of Canada; BC Ministry of Forests |
| Streamflow estimates | WSC HYDAT; Random forest model (not validated) |
| Forest Disturbance | BC Consolidated Cutblocks; BC Historical Wildfire Perimeters — BC Data Catalogue |
| CEF Human Disturbance | BC CEF Disturbance Footprint 2021 — BC Data Catalogue |
| Stream Profile | BC FWA Stream Network XYZ vertices |
| Water Allocations | BC Water Rights Licences; Water Approval Points — BC Data Catalogue |
| ClimateBC | ClimateBC v7.3 (Wang et al. 2016, *PLOS ONE*); CMIP6 13-GCM ensemble |
| Snow Remote Sensing | MODIS Terra/Aqua; VIIRS; Landsat — multi-sensor composite 2001–2023 |
| Landslide Zonation | Copernicus GLO-30 DEM; ClimateBC MAP 1991–2020 |
| Satellite Imagery | USGS Landsat Collection 2 L2; ESA Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A |

**More information:** <https://github.com/Wat-RS/watershedBC/>  
**Contact:** alex.bevington\@unbc.ca
